description: Small Victorian oil portrait of a bearded gentleman, varnished, in a gilt frame, 0.50 x 0.65 m. Front -Y; the back is flat at the back of the bounds (lay it against the wall). Origin is the contract's floor-centre point: the middle of the frame's BOTTOM edge at the wall face; to hang it, place that point at the wanted height of the frame's bottom edge on the wall. No glass (a glazed print would mirror the room in keyframes).
